title: Chorus contours
description: Faces drawn only as contours on bright pastel backgrounds. Every contour is a free line: leaving faces unravel and noodle off the screen, new faces are built from lines that noodle in and coalesce, and faces turn into other faces. Fast music makes it frantic, and a wild slider sets how far it goes.
interaction: use laptop audio, a song or the mic  ·  wild slider  ·  N new scene  ·  B new background  ·  tap to pause
